timeline.body:
What do you think about having the string "all" as a possible value for this param to replace `module_ctx.use_all_repos` (similarly for dev deps)?

The obvious downside is the weird typing, but the advantage of this is that we remove some mental burden and _if_ we were to have other fields on ExtensionMetadata later on, it's more composable.

reply.body:
yeah. now the question is where to put this as_module_extension thing :)

also notable that use_all_repos is implementable in terms of the "all" thing, but not vice versa. Mostly due to the composability point.
Result of an offline discussion: We will go for `"all"`, but realize a wrapper for the simple use case of a WORKSPACE macro either in skylib or Bazel itself.

timeline.body: @Wyverald I pushed a new version that supports the `"all"` syntax. Could you take another look? I would add more tests afterwards.
this builds additional assumptions into the code -- could we just store the module key instead?

I thought the default branch is not needed for enums -- could you double check? if I'm right, not having this default case is better as missing a branch would be a compile error instead of a runtime error.

reply.body: It is still needed for enums with `switch` _statements_. Unfortunately switch _expressions_ aren't available at Bazel's Java language level yet.
I see. This is fine then.

timeline.body: maybe "not declared by the extension as direct dependencies" to clarify that _the extension_ doesn't expect these to be imported, not that the module somehow imported something but didn't "declare it as direct dependencies".

reply.body: I reworded the messages to hopefully make this more clear.
Thanks for catching this, remove the unused function.
